# Every Configuration Key and Whether the Forever Build Reads It

<!-- GENERATED by forever/tools/gen_aiplayerbot_conf.py; do not edit by hand; run the tool. -->

`ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp` advertises 705 keys. The Forever build consumes 377 of them and ships those in `forever/conf/aiplayerbot.conf.dist`; 328 are read into the config object but no compiled file uses the value, so they are not shipped and setting one changes nothing.

**How this is measured.** The compiled file list comes from `CMakeLists.txt` with `TORTOISEBOTS_SLICE1=ON` (the build that ships this config): the `forever/src` glob, the `forever/SLICE-W4.txt` legacy files, the slice and host additions, and the headers those units include. A key is *wired* when its exact name is read by one of those files and the `PlayerbotAIConfig` member it fills is named there too, or when the loader consumes the value at the read itself (a cast, a clamp, a setter). The attribution and consumption rules are `tools/verify_config_usage.py`.
